events.title: Treaty of Meerssen partitions Lotharingia
events.description: Charles the Bald and Louis the German divided the lands of their late nephew Lothair II between West and East Francia. The partition helped shape the later frontier between France and Germany.
events.html: Charles the Bald and Louis the German divided the lands of their late nephew Lothair II between West and East Francia. The partition helped shape the later frontier between France and Germany.

events.title: Foundation stone is laid for Tycho Brahe's Uraniborg
events.description: Work began on Tycho Brahe's observatory on the island of Hven, granted to him by Frederick II of Denmark. Its precise naked-eye observations later allowed Kepler to derive his laws of planetary motion.
events.html: Work began on Tycho Brahe's observatory on the island of Hven, granted to him by Frederick II of Denmark. Its precise naked-eye observations later allowed Kepler to derive his laws of planetary motion.

events.title: Allied attack at Amiens breaks the German line
events.description: British, Australian, Canadian and French troops, with hundreds of tanks, broke through near Amiens. Ludendorff called it the 'black day of the German army'; the Hundred Days Offensive had begun.
events.html: British, Australian, Canadian and French troops, with hundreds of tanks, broke through near Amiens. Ludendorff called it the 'black day of the German army'; the Hundred Days Offensive had begun.

events.title: The Soviet Union declares war on Japan
events.description: Moscow declared war on Japan and, within hours, launched a massive invasion of Manchuria. Coming between the atomic bombings, it helped persuade Japan's leaders to surrender.
events.html: Moscow declared war on Japan and, within hours, launched a massive invasion of Manchuria. Coming between the atomic bombings, it helped persuade Japan's leaders to surrender.

events.title: Richard Nixon announces his resignation
events.description: In a televised address, Richard Nixon said he would resign the presidency at noon the next day. Released tapes had proved his role in the Watergate cover-up, leaving him facing certain impeachment.
